maya: Quick kickoff for Needlepoint benchmark launch — goal: clear developer-first narrative + 3 succinct visuals.
toni: Agree. Keep public messaging simple, appendix for methodology.
james: Proposed visuals: 1) heatmap (QPS vs seq len -> $/1k tokens), 2) tail-latency lines (p50/p95/p99), 3) throughput-per-$ bar with deployment variants.
manila: Webinar idea: interactive slider for batch size + prefix-cache toggle so attendees see cost delta live. Good for eng audiences. :thinking_face: 
anita: Copy angle: developer-first, avoid absolute multipliers. Suggested header: "Trade latency for cost with predictable levers."
maya: Routing: two CTAs on landing — "Request demo" -> Enterprise SDRs, "Try benchmark" -> Growth sandbox. Add utm_campaign=needlepoint_launch.
james: benchbot run: model=redwood-v1-small qps=50 batch=8 mean=48ms p95=210ms cost_per_1k=0.27 — can use as an example in the appendix.
toni: Two qualified claims to surface: "Typical chat: 50 QPS → ~$0.27/1k tokens, p95 <220ms" and "Batch + prefix-cache can reduce cost ~4x for batch-friendly workloads." Mark both as qualified.
manila: Segmentation notes: SMB copy emphasizes cost/conversation; Enterprise emphasizes SLA, fallbacks, and rollout tooling. Also mark interactive-demo watchers as high-intent for routing.
anita: I'll draft landing + 3 social snippets, include 3 subject lines for A/B tests. EOD Thursday target.
james: I'll add chart mocks + CSVs to drive and include alt text. Link will be posted when ready.
manila: I'll sanity-check the heatmap palette for colorblind accessibility.
maya: Deliverables: @anita copy, @james visuals/interactive, @toni webinar script and slides. I'll assemble public one-pager + internal appendix after drafts are in. :fire:
benchbot: scheduled nightly-needlepoint run in ~24h.
